description: The ONE contract for a grain: which product line+group (+optional program) a lead is stamped with, and which catalog fields may be carried. It is read by every lead-intake surface — the partner API resolves it from the caller, an intake form and a Facebook lead source each link to one. Routing is forced from here and can never be set by the submitter.

fields.label: Contract Name
fields.description: The name this contract is known by, and the last part of its id. It is required because two contracts may legitimately share one grain — two partners on the same product line, or a short and a long intake form. It is expected to be short and descriptive, e.g. 'Anaya Partner API' or 'Facebook GoodFlip'.

fields.label: Partner User
fields.description: The external login this contract is bound to. When set, that partner's API calls resolve to this contract and no other — one login, one contract, enforced by the database. It is left BLANK for an internal contract, one an intake form or a Facebook lead source links to directly, where there is no login to resolve from; a blank is stored as NULL, and any number of internal contracts may exist.

fields.label: Forced Routing (stamped on every lead this partner creates)
Program
fields.description: Pin the key to ONE program (forced on every lead). Leave BLANK for a multi-program key (e.g. Anaya) — then the caller must send the program per lead, limited to Allowed Programs.

fields.label: Allowed Programs
fields.description: Used ONLY when Program above is blank. The set of programs this key may set per lead; a lead's program must be one of these.

fields.label: Allowed Fields
fields.description: Tick the fields this partner may send/read. Leave empty to allow the full catalog. mobile_no is always allowed.

name: CRM Lead API Mapping
